name: JLCPCB
scope: Rigid FR-4, multilayer (4 layers), 1 oz outer and 0.5 oz inner copper, standard options
notes: The page does not label standard and advanced tiers. 0.1 mm drills and 0.1/0.2 mm vias cost extra and need a board of 1 mm or less with ENIG or OSP, so they are not used here.
Values marked unverified were not read word for word from the page. Their findings are warnings, not errors.
